notes.title: Move Out Manor 2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Our Vision[/h2]

Since we originally created [b]Move Out Manor[/b], our skills have grown quite a lot. We always imagined improving the look and presentation of the game to match our original vision. Of course, we only thought we'd [i]eventually[/i] get around to it.

[u]We decided not to wait[/u], however, and improved the look and feel of [b]Move Out Manor[/b] to give players a better experience than ever before. Our intention was to preserve the essence of the original release and the launch stages, but give them all an extra layer of polish. Now we can present to you: [b]Move Out Manor 2.0[/b].

[h2]General Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unified color scheme
[*] New items
[*] New ghosts
[*] Brand new boss design
[*] New animations
[*] Improved game design for packing items
[*] Re-imagined Lobby stage
[*] Re-imagined Library stage
[*] Streamlined stage order
[*] Best overall time tracking
[*] New music
[*] New sound effects
[/list]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

Thank you all for playing [b]Move Out Manor[/b]. This version brings our original vision to life and we hope that you enjoy the improved stages, art, and sound as much as we do. While we probably won't do a major update like this again, we will continue to dutifully fix any issues that pop up.

notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Version 1.3.0 is our last planned release for the year. A general note is that the old save files will no longer work due to the addition of the two new stages and a modification to an existing stage.

[h2]Content Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 new levels and 1 new hall.
[*] 2 new music tracks during boss fights.
[*] Second boss (Prince Golgo) now has his own color scheme.
[/list]
[h2]General Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reverted Golem Garden to the original design.
[/list]

Have fun everyone,
Baluster Games

notes.title: Patch Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
This is the first patch for “Move Out Manor” since release.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed in-level timer since there’s no time limit.
[*]Improved hint in hall #2.
[*]Added more controller support.
[*]Tweaks to hall #6 boss.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved “Fullscreen” option on Windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Move Out Manor IN ... Scream Fest 3D!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween week everyone. It is a whole week, right? At least it is during Steam's Scream Fest 3D!

"Move Out Manor" is happy to offer a kinder, gentler level of fright next to some truly terrifying games. Spooky ghosts offer some nice contrast to terrifying monsters, after all. The game is steeped in horror stories and movies of the past. In particular, that vibe you get when exploring an abandoned creepy mansion.

We're offering a 15% discount all the way through Scream Fest and put up a Free Demo version of the game so that you can give it a try first.

Don't forget that "Move Out Manor" will be receiving a special Halloween update for the day of, so keep an eye out for that. Til then, have a good, spooky week.

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
Yes, it’s launch day alright! “Move Out Manor” has been in development for about 9 months based on an engine and game we made for a game jam years ago. When we started we weren’t sure where we’d end up, but we managed to transform our silly game jam entry into a full game. We went from a game about moving furniture out of a tilting house to an action puzzle game where you help Alec free an old manor house from its ghosts by packing up everything in sight. Okay, so maybe that’s not [i]that[/i] different on paper, but we didn’t even have ghosts or conveyor belts in the original game jam game!

While October 25, 2024 marks the release of “Move Out Manor,” it does not mark the end of development. At least not entirely. Here are a few things we’re planning.

[h2]Halloween Easter Eggs[/h2]
Check out the game on Halloween to find a number of special Easter eggs added just for the occasion. We’ll have a community post all about it next week.

[h2]Back Story[/h2]
We plan to incorporate more of the game’s story line both into the game and into a community post. If you’re curious about the manor’s mysterious past, stay tuned. More information is just around the corner!

[h2]Commitment to Quality[/h2]
It goes without saying that we plan to stay on top of any bugs, performance, or quality issues found by players. We want “Move Out Manor” to be a high quality experience and we want to do everything we can to maintain that standard. If you encounter any issues, feel free to post in the community hub and we’ll look into it as soon as possible.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Most importantly, thank you for playing, rating, and discussing our game. We hope you enjoy the game and look forward to hearing what you think.

notes.title: Next Fest October 2024
notes.content:
Next Fest is starting October 14 and Move Out Manor will be there. We'll be showcasing an updated demo incorporating all the feedback we've received. Stay tuned for patch notes, but here is a sneak peek at the upcoming changes.

Changes

- Improved UI colors.
- Improved controls.
- Improved movement.
- Adjusted difficulty of 1st boss.
- Various level improvements.
